params.prompt: Cinematic miniature diorama, heroic armored-tech workshop aesthetic: glossy hot-rod red and gold metal plating with crisp panel lines and rivets, brushed gunmetal accents, warm tungsten garage lighting, subtle cool reactor-glow highlights, tilt-shift miniature photography look, isometric three-quarter aerial view, ultra detailed, empty, unoccupied, no people, architectural model quality. On a plain solid deep warm charcoal background with a soft contact shadow. Palette: hot-rod red #B91C1C, gold #D4A017, gunmetal #3F3F46, reactor glow #7DD3FC, warm white #FAF7F0. No text, no letters, no logos, centered composition. Subject: a logistics hangar bay — rows of docked armored cargo drones in red and gold, stacked shipping crates and parcels moving on conveyor belts, an overhead loading gantry crane, huge hangar doors half open with warm light spilling in.
